title: OpenBSD 8.0 expands virtual machines and brings a proposed Wine port
extract: OpenBSD 8.0 raises the x86-64 kernel virtual-memory address space to 512GB, supports multiprocessor virtual machines with up to 64 vCPUs, adds Arm64 hibernation and updates OpenSSH, LibreSSL and graphics drivers. Separately, a proposed 64-bit Wine port could let some Windows applications run on OpenBSD.

title: Signal calling bug could leave audio or video active after hangup
extract: A flaw in Signal's RingRTC calling library could prevent a hang-up request from being processed if its event queue is overwhelmed. The fixed library version is 2.72.0; users should update their Signal apps to ensure they have the corrected code.

title: AI speeds up coding but floods open-source maintainers with low-quality pull requests
extract: A Linux Foundation survey found maintainers estimate that about a quarter of incoming pull requests are low-quality AI-generated contributions, rising to 31% on larger projects. Respondents said generative AI reduced code-authoring time, while raising new challenges around review, trust and project policies.

title: Aston Martin unveils a special United States Grand Prix livery
extract: Aston Martin's AMR26 will wear a one-off light-blue-accented design at Austin to mark five years of partnership with Cognizant. The team says the livery celebrates the collaboration, which now includes Cognizant's role as its Global AI Services Partner.

title: Ferrari's United States Grand Prix livery turns the car into an engineering blueprint
extract: Ferrari and title partner HP have created a special SF-26 livery covered in technical sketches, power-unit schematics and gearbox drawings. The design is intended to put the engineering work behind a Formula 1 car centre stage and will run on both Ferrari cars in Austin.

title: Female Life on Planet Earth explores a mother's hidden past
extract: Laleh Khadivi's novel follows an Iranian-American woman who receives photographs suggesting her late mother was involved in the Iranian Revolution's repression of other women. The review highlights the book's mix of family secrets, sardonic domestic observations and questions about inheritance, identity and grief.

title: Black Bag turns a bizarre campus experiment into a comic audiobook
extract: Luke Kennard narrates his Booker-shortlisted novel about an unemployed London actor paid to sit inside a black leather bag during university seminars. The review praises Kennard's comic timing while noting the story's more serious reflections on relationships and masculinity.

title: Taika Waititi's Star Wars film is put on ice
extract: Taika Waititi says his long-announced Star Wars film has been shelved, joining several other proposed franchise projects that have failed to reach cinemas. The commentary argues Lucasfilm needs to take creative risks and allow distinctive filmmakers to finish new stories rather than repeatedly announcing projects that stall.

title: Diana Reid reimagines Sense and Sensibility for a new film
extract: Australian novelist Diana Reid adapted Jane Austen's novel for a new film directed by Georgia Oakley, writing most of the dialogue herself. Reid says the adaptation foregrounds the relationship between Elinor and Marianne Dashwood, presenting their growth as sisters as the story's emotional centre.
